negative_sales_analysis.domain_interpretation: Negative weekly sales represent net customer merchandise returns, refunds, or debit inventory reconciliation adjustments that exceeded weekly sales volume. These are authentic business transactions, not data transmission errors.
negative_sales_analysis.handling_decision: Do NOT delete negative sales. Maintain an indicator `is_negative_return`. For models requiring positive targets (log transforms, MAPE denominators), clip to zero or use an offset.

holiday_surge_investigation.handling_decision: Extreme high sales are driven by genuine holiday surge dynamics (Black Friday / Thanksgiving and Christmas). Deleting high outliers would destroy the seasonal peak signal, causing critical inventory under-replenishment. All high values are retained; models use holiday interaction features and tree splits to capture the non-linear surge.
